leadership.summary: Accountable for overall performance, shipyard operations, and delivery of the strategic business plan.
Supports executive oversight across production, commercial, and corporate functions.

yards.name: Mombasa Shipyard
yards.summary: Coastal new build, naval refit, and heavy steel work with dry berth access at Mtongwe.

yards.name: Kisumu Shipyard
yards.summary: Lake Victoria ferries, GRP craft, and inland fleet maintenance along Marine Drive.

milestonesLead: From the first yard works to MV Uhuru II entering the water.

milestones.title: Mombasa yard begins
milestones.summary: The slipway site beside the port, later able to take a 4,000 tonne vessel.

milestones.title: KSL is incorporated
milestones.summary: A state corporation under the Ministry of Defence, approved by the National Security Council.

milestones.title: Kisumu is upgraded
milestones.summary: Dry dock, slipways, and quay prepared for larger vessels on Lake Victoria.

milestones.title: Keel of MV Uhuru II
milestones.summary: The Kisumu yard is launched and the hull of MV Uhuru II is formally started.

milestones.title: Mombasa opens
milestones.summary: Slipway, buildings, workshops, and cranes are handed over for use.

milestones.title: Locomotives return
milestones.summary: The same workshops that serve hulls rehabilitate rail equipment.

milestones.title: Uhuru II floats
milestones.summary: The hull meets the water, about fourteen months after the keel was laid.
